prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A lone man seen from behind, his face never visible, on a rock in the rising water, and a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, far off in the rain, the roof empty and flat. Grey dusk, rain and mist. Final and quiet. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
